notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA listing (standing, Lee County) and TopoQuest (Lee County, 2,519 ft, named Hunter Lookout Tower) confirm the tower. Wikipedia names the gap, not the tower. The DHR and DOF pages give statewide context only and do not name this tower. Two web searches found no build date, builder, design, staffing, ownership or access record. The FFLA name and the topo name differ; the record name was kept. Confidence low.
